parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description:
The end timestamp of the query.
Minimum value: 1000000000000 ms
Maximum value: 2000000000000 ms.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description:
The language of the reports to retrieve. Default value: the browser language. Valid values:
- en: English
- zh: Simplified Chinese
- zt: Traditional Chinese
- es: Spanish
- fr: French

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number. Default value: 1. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 200.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of report IDs per page. Default value: 10. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 500.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description:
The start timestamp of the query.
Minimum value: 1000000000000 ms
Maximum value: 2000000000000 ms.

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description: The trigger method of the health diagnostics. Valid values: SYSTEM (automatically triggered by the system), INNER (internally triggered), and USER (manually triggered by the user).
